sources.title: ALADIN (Acne Lesion And Density INdex): a novel tool for automatic acne ...
sources.snippet: Published in Skin Health and Disease (Oxford Academic), this peer-reviewed study introduces ALADIN (Acne Lesion And Density INdex), an artificial intelligence-driven tool that combines inflammatory lesion count and spatial density from facial images to produce reproducible, interpretable acne severity scores aligned with the Investigator Global Assessment (IGA) scale.

sources.title: DERMA AI: Real-Time Skin Disease Identification Using CNNs for Acne and ...
sources.snippet: This study proposes a real-time skin disease identification system utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for automated classification of acne and actinic keratosis. The proposed model is trained on a dataset comprising acne and benign skin cancer images, leveraging deep feature extraction for precise lesion detection and classification.

sources.title: Artificial Intelligence in the Assessment and Grading of Acne ... - MDPI
sources.snippet: Background/Objectives: This review aims to systematically assess the recent advancements in artificial intelligence (AI) applications for acne diagnosis, lesion segmentation/counting, and severity grading, highlighting the potential of AI-driven methods to improve objectivity, reproducibility, and clinical efficiency.

sources.title: Frontiers | Development and validation of an artificial intelligence ...
sources.snippet: Abstract Background: The management of acne requires the consideration of its severity; however, a universally adopted evaluation system for clinical practice is lacking. Artificial intelligence (AI) evaluation systems hold the promise of enhancing the efficiency and reproducibility of assessments.
